recentItems.title: 24h with the BISON HORN Tribe of India (Rare)
recentItems.description:
Download the Airalo app for free today and use my code MIKEC3 to get $3 off your first eSIM.
https://try.airalo.com/fearlessandfar

We spent 24 hours living with the Bison Horn Maria tribe deep in India.

From bartering at the local market and drinking moonshine, to making ant chutney and catching a pig for a massive village feast, this was a wild glimpse into a way of life few outsiders ever get to experience.

recentItems.title: Testing Hawaii's DEADLIEST Ancient Weapon
recentItems.description:
I spent 15 years figuring out how to build an adventurous life.
You don't have to. Join The Order of Explorers. ⚔️ https://www.skool.com/oxe/

Ancient Hawaiians built some of the most brutal weapons in history... but how effective were they really?

In this episode, we put traditional Polynesian shark-tooth weapons to the test. From fruit and everyday targets to a ballistics gel dummy, we're finding out just how much damage these legendary weapons can do.

Will the shark teeth slice cleanly? Shatter on impact? Or live up to their fearsome reputation?

recentItems.title: Catching MONSTER Tuna in Louisiana (182lbs)
recentItems.description:
I spent 15 years figuring out how to build an adventurous life.
You don't have to. Join The Order of Explorers. ⚔️ https://www.skool.com/oxe/

You wouldn't think fishing in Louisiana would land us a monster. In this adventure we hooked a massive tuna, and then we did something that made even less sense.

We climbed onto an abandoned oil rig and ate sashimi right there. No plates. Later, we ended up in a fisherman’s bar, and ended up forgetting most of the rest.

Here's a tale that almost didn't get told.

Go tuna fishing in Louisiana here: https://www.mgfishing.com/

recentItems.title: I Hunted Monkeys with Poison Darts in the Amazon
recentItems.description:
I spent 15 years figuring out how to build an adventurous life.
You don't have to. Join The Order of Explorers. ⚔️ https://www.skool.com/oxe/

Deep in the Amazon Jungle, we hunted, lived, and ate alongside the Waorani Tribe in Ecuador’s Yasuni National Park. We learned their ancient survival traditions. From crafting deadly poison darts and hunting with blowpipes, to making chicha (spit beer) and sharing fresh piranha, this was one of the most raw and unforgettable tribal experiences we've ever had.
